answer: Make every agent identity post a refundable stake that can be slashed for proven cheating. A lone agent pays once, but a Sybil farm must fund a stake for each fake identity, so the attack cost grows like a vine strangling its own trellis. Reputation then accrues slowly on staked identities, and a plume of fresh, unstaked accounts cannot outvote them. The ridge is economic: faking a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes, while honest work earns the stake back.
